name: Qwen3.6-Whittle-25B-A3B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA plus gated linear attention: 30 of 40 layers are linear_attention and 10 are full_attention, one every fourth layer
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A distillation of Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 25.091 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-02. Caveats: exactly ONE printed row beats the base, and the card itself frames it as 'at least parity' - a 4-point GSM8K gain attributed to a maths-format SFT pass the parent never had. Held-out cross-entropy on corpus text is WORSE (1.770 -> 1.863) and on chat rows better (2.510 -> 1.417). 30% of routed experts were pruned (256 -> 180/layer) and healed by self-distillation, so the win is a pruning-recovery result, not a general capability gain. Do not rank this against 25B models on GSM8K alone.

benchmarks.name: GSM8K (200 q, no-think, greedy, 512 tok)
benchmarks.config: Card table cols 'Qwen3.6-35B-A3B | Qwen3.6-Whittle-25B-A3B': GSM8K 88.5% vs 92.5% (185/200). Same 200 questions, same no-think greedy setting. Card itself calls this at-least-parity; held-out CE on corpus text is WORSE (1.770 -> 1.863).
